items.summary_zh: COSCO 将条形码单突触 rabies tracing 与单细胞 RNA-seq 结合，在脑类器官中重建超过 10,000 个神经网络，并分析 Tuberous Sclerosis Complex 模型的拓扑重连。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该技术把单神经元连接性与转录状态联结，为研究人类神经发育网络自组织及疾病扰动提供了高通量实验基础。
items.abstract_zh: 功能性神经网络随着发育中的神经元形成突触连接而出现。揭示这些连接如何组织、以及如何在疾病中被扰动，需要在数千个网络中将单神经元连接性与分子状态相连接，而现有方法难以做到这一点。我们开发了 COSCO（Connectomics by Sequencing in Cerebral Organoids），将条形码单突触 rabies tracing 与单细胞 RNA 测序相结合，在脑类器官中重建超过 10,000 个网络。我们证明，类器官网络可自组织成由细胞内在布线规则支配的、刻板的网络基序，这些规则与小鼠皮层连接性的特征相一致。将网络拓扑投射至转录组空间后显示，布线与细胞黏附和突触基因表达程序相关。在一个 Tuberous Sclerosis Complex 模型中，病理性过度兴奋与拓扑重连并存：突变网络变得更加异质，这由上层兴奋性细胞状态的转录分布驱动。这项工作确立了脑类器官作为研究人类连接性自组织及其在神经发育疾病中受扰动的模型。
items.author_line: Vertesy, A., Najm, R., Doleschall, B., Isaev, S., Zabolocki, M., Novatchkova, M., Burkard, T. R., Ziegler, C., Krautberger, S., Li, C. V., Adameyko, I., Knoblich, J. A.

items.title: REFinder: Mining new enzymes from metagenomes
items.abstract_or_text: Microbial metagenomes encode vast catalytic diversity, but recovering enzymes of novel, yet-undescribed functionality typically requires whole-community assembly plus a means of identifying active proteins ab initio. The first step of the task is compute-intensive and misses low-abundance sequences. The second is complicated by our inability to predict novel functions. REBEAN, our DNA language model, sidesteps the latter by assigning each sequencing read a high-level Enzyme Commission (EC) class or a non-enzyme label without alignment. Here we build REFinder, a pipeline that addresses both steps by routing REBEAN-annotated reads to assemble only the putative enzymatic reads that have identified catalytic signatures. In our evaluation of 50 microbiome metagenomes, REFinder identified 1.2 to 2.1 fold more enzymes than could be recovered via homology-based annotation of the proteins from the corresponding full assemblies. Moreover, it was as much as 6.4-fold cheaper computationally than full assembly. Across all samples, REFinder identified at least three fourths and as many as 90% of the homology-accessible enzymes identified via full assembly of the complete metagenomes. Notably, a fraction of these, 22% to 45% per EC class, carried no similarity to Swiss-Prot proteins, i.e. a set of enzymes homology cannot annotate. For roughly two fifths of the over thirteen thousand such novel oxidoreductases from two saliva samples, ESMFold predicted structures aligned with TM-score[≥]0.7 to a characterized enzyme structure in the PDB - a substantial structural similarity without sequence homology. These results illustrate that targeted, alignment-free assembly turns even well-mapped microbiomes into a source of thousands of previously invisible but credible novel enzymes, raising our expectations for exploration of environmental microbiomes.
items.summary_zh: REFinder 利用 DNA 语言模型 REBEAN 对宏基因组读段作无比对酶类注释并进行靶向组装，在 50 个微生物组中发现更多候选酶且降低计算成本。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把语言模型、靶向组装和结构预测用于发掘同源性检索遗漏的酶，为环境微生物组的酶资源探索提供可量化路线。
items.abstract_zh: 微生物宏基因组编码了巨大的催化多样性，但要恢复具有新颖而尚未描述功能的酶，通常需要对整个群落进行组装，并需要一种从头识别活性蛋白的方法。该任务的第一步计算密集，且会漏掉低丰度序列。第二步则因我们无法预测新功能而变得复杂。我们的 DNA 语言模型 REBEAN 通过在无需比对的情况下为每条测序读段分配一个高级别 Enzyme Commission（EC）类别或非酶标签，绕开了后一难题。在此，我们构建 REFinder：一条流水线，通过将 REBEAN 注释的读段路由至组装，以仅组装那些具有已识别催化特征的推定酶读段，从而同时解决两步问题。在对 50 个微生物组宏基因组的评估中，REFinder 识别出的酶数量是通过相应完整组装蛋白的同源性注释所能恢复数量的 1.2 至 2.1 倍。而且，它的计算成本最高比完整组装低 6.4 倍。跨所有样本，REFinder 识别出完整宏基因组组装所发现的、可由同源性访问的酶中的至少四分之三，最高达 90%。值得注意的是，其中一部分——每个 EC 类别为 22% 至 45%——与 Swiss-Prot 蛋白不具有相似性，即同源性无法注释的一组酶。在两个唾液样本中，超过 13,000 个此类新颖 oxidoreductases 中约五分之二，ESMFold 预测的结构与 PDB 中已表征酶结构的比对 TM-score≥0.7：即在没有序列同源性的情况下具有显著的结构相似性。这些结果表明，靶向、无比对组装可将即使已有良好图谱的微生物组变成数千种此前不可见但可信的新颖酶的来源，并提高我们对探索环境微生物组的期待。
items.author_line: Prabakaran, R., Bromberg, Y.

items.title: Cost-Efficient Theorem Proving via Agent Orchestration in Program Verification
items.abstract_or_text: Program verification establishes software correctness through machine-checkable proofs constructed in theorem provers. It's a guarantee especially valuable for code generated by large language models (LLMs), which is fluent but carries no assurance of correctness. Almost all existing provers, however, pursue pass rates alone at whatever sampling or search budget it takes, and overlook the success-vs-cost frontier; yet real software often carries hundreds of interdependent proof obligations, so what matters at scale is not whether one theorem can be proved, but how many can be proved economically. We introduce CoCo-Prover, which formalizes cost-efficient program proving as metalevel decision-making under cost, grounded on two-level proof graphs: an AND/OR proof hypergraph within each declaration is joined to a lemma-dependency graph across declarations; and at each step, it answers two questions: which open goals to select, and which actions to purchase on these goals. Selection stays symbolic as a topological pass over the proof graphs. Action choice is agent orchestration via metalevel decision-making: an agentic router treats every bounded specialist invocation as a separately priced, best-effort computation, matching heterogeneous specialist agents together with configurations, under evolved routing rules as evidence accumulates. On five program verification benchmarks in Lean 4 including function-level CLEVER, VERINA, and AlgoVeri, and repository-level NTP4VC and Vero, we show that CoCo-Prover achieves a better success-vs-cost frontier than baselines including frontier coding agents and state-of-the-art LLM-based provers: it achieves the best solve rate on every benchmark and up to 100% on two benchmarks. It also reduces cost by up to 30.9% compared to the strongest baseline with the strongest LLM in our evaluation.
items.summary_zh: CoCo-Prover 将 Lean 4 程序验证中的证明搜索建模为兼顾成本的元层决策：在声明内使用 AND/OR 证明超图、在声明间使用引理依赖图，并以路由器协调按次计费的专业代理。在五个函数级与仓库级基准上，论文报告其求解率均最高，并将相对最强基线的成本最多降低 30.9%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将证明成功率与调用成本一并评估，且覆盖多个 Lean 4 验证基准；其结果仍是预印本中的实验报告，不应外推为对任意程序验证任务的保证。
items.abstract_zh: 程序验证通过在定理证明器中构造机器可检验的证明来确立软件正确性。对于由大语言模型（LLM）生成的代码，这种保证尤其有价值：此类代码虽流畅，却没有正确性保证。然而，几乎所有现有证明器都只是在所需的任意采样或搜索预算下追求通过率，忽视了成功率与成本之间的前沿；但真实软件往往有数百个相互依赖的证明义务，因此在规模化场景中，重要的并非能否证明一个定理，而是能以何种经济成本证明多少定理。我们提出 CoCo-Prover，它将高成本效率的程序证明形式化为成本约束下的元层决策，其基础是两层证明图：每个声明内部的 AND/OR 证明超图与跨声明的引理依赖图相连接；在每一步，它回答两个问题：选择哪些未完成目标，以及为这些目标购买哪些动作。目标选择保持符号化，表现为在证明图上进行拓扑遍历。动作选择则是通过元层决策进行的代理编排：一个代理路由器将每次受限的专业调用视为单独计价、尽力而为的计算，在证据不断累积的演化路由规则下，将异质专业代理与配置相匹配。我们在 Lean 4 的五个程序验证基准上进行测试，包括函数级的 CLEVER、VERINA 和 AlgoVeri，以及仓库级的 NTP4VC 和 Vero。结果显示，相比包括前沿编码代理和最先进的基于 LLM 的证明器在内的基线，CoCo-Prover 取得了更优的成功率—成本前沿：它在每个基准上都达到最高求解率，并在两个基准上最高达到 100%。与我们评估中使用最强 LLM 的最强基线相比，它还将成本最多降低了 30.9%。
items.author_line: Shuangjie Yao, Nikolaus Holzer, Mark Paul Santolucito, Baishakhi Ray, Suman Jana, Dongdong She

items.title: Multi-Aspect Runtime Verification for Simulation-Based V&V of LLM-Enabled Autonomous Agents
items.abstract_or_text: LLM-based agents are entering decision-support roles in defence staff work, where the obligations they must respect are already written down and binding, and where retraining is not available as a control because models arrive as procured components. What can be placed under engineering control is the interface between the agent and the systems it acts on. Those obligations are at once spatial, temporal and text-semantic, and a violation typically lives in the composition of a multi-step interaction, which is why per-event guardrails miss sequential tool-attack chains. We present a multi-aspect runtime-verification framework that decomposes a natural-language policy clause into a typed spatial/temporal/semantic triple over one canonical event stream, checks each aspect with its own monitoring specification, and fuses the verdicts through a four-valued algebra that carries provenance. The spatial aspect is interpreted over a weighted two-sorted location graph in which mission geometry and information-release topology are one object; we show that these spatial obligations are not in general subsumed by a first-order temporal specification. The past-time aspect runs on the unmodified MonPoly engine, which agrees with our reference monitor at every time point. Across two mission domains, casualty evacuation and contested sustainment, and one civil domain, composition under the precautionary blocking policy drives attack success to zero with no observed false positives and microsecond-scale per-event cost, while every single aspect and every pair leaves a substantial share of attacks succeeding. In a closed-loop experiment a policy-naive planner reaches a violating state in most unshielded missions and in none when shielded, and four refused episodes in five still recover to a compliant outcome.
items.summary_zh: 该工作将自然语言政策拆为同一事件流上的空间、时间和语义三类监测规范，并以带溯源的四值代数融合判定。在三个模拟领域中，组合式监测器报告将攻击成功率降至零、未观察到假阳性，且具有微秒级单事件开销。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作给出了可运行时检查的多维规范、参考监测器一致性检查及闭环实验；结论限于所用任务域和模拟攻击设置。
items.abstract_zh: 基于 LLM 的代理正进入国防参谋工作中的决策支持角色，在这些角色中，它们必须遵守的义务已经被写明且具有约束力；由于模型是作为采购组件到来的，再训练无法作为控制手段。能够置于工程控制之下的是代理与其所作用系统之间的接口。这些义务同时具有空间、时间和文本语义维度，而违规通常存在于多步交互的组合中，这就是为何逐事件护栏会漏掉连续工具攻击链。我们提出一种多方面运行时验证框架，将自然语言政策条款分解为同一规范事件流上带类型的空间/时间/语义三元组，用各自的监测规范检查每个方面，并通过携带溯源信息的四值代数融合判定。空间方面在加权双排序位置图上解释，其中任务几何与信息释放拓扑构成同一对象；我们表明，这些空间义务通常不能被一阶时间规范所涵盖。过去时态方面运行在未经修改的 MonPoly 引擎上，并且在每个时间点都与我们的参考监测器一致。在两个任务领域——伤员后送和争议地区补给——以及一个民用领域中，采用预防性阻断策略的组合将攻击成功率降至零，没有观察到假阳性，且每个事件的成本达到微秒级；而任一单独方面和任意两方面的组合都仍有相当一部分攻击成功。在闭环实验中，政策未知的规划器在大多数未受屏蔽的任务中达到违规状态，而受屏蔽时一个也没有；五个被拒绝的回合中有四个仍恢复到合规结果。
items.author_line: Nikolaos Kekatos, Dimitrios Nikou, Anastasios Temperekidis, Alexios Lekidis, Nikolaos Kolokotronis, Panagiotis Katsaros, Stylianos Basagiannis

items.title: BoT-GRPO: Efficient Process-Reward RL for Reasoning via Bag-of-Token Aggregation
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning is now central to eliciting reasoning in large language models, while in the popular algorithm Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) every token in a rollout receives the same advantage. We ask how to make process supervision efficient: accelerating convergence and improving final quality without the cost of value networks. We propose Bag-of-Tokens Group Relative Policy Optimization (BoT-GRPO), which extends GRPO to token-level reward models through a length-invariant "bag of tokens" aggregation: it collects all token-level rewards across rollouts, weights each by the inverse of its source sequence length, and computes per-token advantages relative to weighted group statistics. BoT-GRPO is critic-free, and is a drop-in replacement wherever GRPO is used when token-level reward is available. On React front-end code generation, BoT-GRPO reaches 80\% compile rate up to 1.9\times faster than GRPO and converges faster than modern GRPO variants (GSPO, DAPO, PURE) while reaching higher final compile and VLM-judged win rates. On a second task, AIME mathematical reasoning, BoT-GRPO delivers absolute Pass@k gains up to 8.1\% over GRPO in half the steps. For both tasks we compare the algorithm's performance on reasoning vs. non-reasoning base-model families (Qwen2.5-3B, SmolLM3-3B, Phi-4-mini-reasoning). Our experiments also yield a practical recipe for the reward model itself: reward stability matters more than richness: clean, bounded, stable fine-grained signals consistently accelerate learning where noisier alternatives stall.
items.summary_zh: BoT-GRPO 以按序列长度加权的 token 奖励聚合替代 GRPO 对整段轨迹共享优势值的做法，无需价值网络。在 React 代码生成和 AIME 数学推理中，论文报告其收敛更快；AIME 的 Pass@k 相对 GRPO 最多提高 8.1 个百分点，且训练步数减半。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法把过程奖励落实到 token 级比较，并给出代码与 AIME 两类任务的对照；数学能力提升只是在所测模型、奖励和基准条件下报告的结果。
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习如今是激发大语言模型推理能力的核心手段，而在流行算法 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）中，一条 rollout 的每个 token 都获得相同的优势值。我们探讨如何在不承担价值网络成本的情况下，使过程监督更高效：加快收敛并提高最终质量。我们提出 Bag-of-Tokens Group Relative Policy Optimization（BoT-GRPO），它通过一种与长度无关的“词元袋”聚合，将 GRPO 扩展到 token 级奖励模型：它收集各个 rollout 中的所有 token 级奖励，按其源序列长度的倒数对每个奖励加权，并相对于加权的组统计量计算每个 token 的优势值。BoT-GRPO 不使用评论家网络，并且只要 token 级奖励可用，就可以在任何使用 GRPO 的地方直接替换 GRPO。在 React 前端代码生成上，BoT-GRPO 的编译率达到 80%，相较 GRPO 最多快 1.9 倍，并且比现代 GRPO 变体（GSPO、DAPO、PURE）收敛更快，同时达到更高的最终编译率和由 VLM 评判的胜率。在第二项任务 AIME 数学推理上，BoT-GRPO 在一半训练步数内相较 GRPO 带来最高 8.1% 的绝对 Pass@k 增益。对于两项任务，我们比较了该算法在推理型与非推理型基础模型系列（Qwen2.5-3B、SmolLM3-3B、Phi-4-mini-reasoning）上的表现。我们的实验还给出了关于奖励模型本身的实用结论：奖励稳定性比丰富性更重要；干净、有界、稳定的细粒度信号能持续加速学习，而噪声更大的替代信号会停滞。
items.author_line: Yingxiang Yang, Weihang Xiao, Zhunxuan Wang, Joshua Flashner, Niresh Agarwal

items.title: Algorithmic Scratchpads and Curriculum Staging for Arithmetic Reasoning in Tiny Transformers
items.abstract_or_text: Autoregressive Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently struggle with deterministic multi-step algorithmic tasks such as multi-digit multiplication and long division. In this paper, we investigate the mechanics of multi-step arithmetic in compact "Tiny" Transformers (~10.6M non-embedding parameters, 49.3M total) trained on synthetic data across four basic operations (+, -, *, /) unrolled as step-by-step scratchpads. First, we establish the necessary training foundations: (1) dataloader sequence padding creates an 83% gradient starvation artifact that collapses accuracy from 40% to 1%, remediated via continuous sequence packing; (2) linguistic pretraining is an essential prerequisite (<= 2.0% without it); and (3) modern architectural primitives (RoPE, RMSNorm, SwiGLU) and Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) substantially improve additive reasoning over baseline GPT-2. Second, we demonstrate that algorithmic scratchpad formulation directly dictates success. Introducing a deterministic Digit-by-Digit Long Division scratchpad within a 4-stage Hierarchical Developmental Curriculum dramatically elevates single-digit division from 4.0% to 86.7% accuracy on a 4,000-problem held-out benchmark. In contrast, multi-digit multiplication remained challenging: detailed error analysis revealed that while the model correctly computed single-digit sub-products and place-value zeros, our FOIL scratchpad failed because it forced a simultaneous summation of up to nine multi-digit terms in a single step without pairwise intermediate accumulation. Finally, we identify two key boundaries: performance collapses to 0.00% on unseen 4-digit operands, and unbuffered training induces catastrophic forgetting, collapsing division accuracy from 86.7% down to 0.00%.
items.summary_zh: 研究考察约 1060 万非嵌入参数的小型 Transformer 在四则运算 scratchpad 上的表现。逐位长除法 scratchpad 配合四阶段课程，将单数字除法的留出集准确率从 4.0% 提高到 86.7%，但未见过的四位操作数准确率降至 0%，也出现灾难性遗忘。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它同时报告有效设置与明确的泛化失败边界，且有 4,000 题留出集评测；这说明所测算术程序并不等同于通用数学推理能力。
items.abstract_zh: 自回归大语言模型（LLM）经常难以处理多位数乘法和长除法等确定性的多步算法任务。本文研究在合成数据上训练的紧凑型“Tiny” Transformer（约 1060 万个非嵌入参数、4930 万个总参数）进行多步算术的机制；数据覆盖四种基本运算（+、-、*、/），并展开为逐步 scratchpad。首先，我们确立必要的训练基础：（1）数据加载器的序列填充会造成 83% 的梯度饥饿伪影，使准确率从 40% 降至 1%，可通过连续序列打包修复；（2）语言预训练是必要前提（没有它时准确率不超过 2.0%）；（3）现代架构原语（RoPE、RMSNorm、SwiGLU）和稀疏混合专家（MoE）相比基线 GPT-2 显著改善加法推理。其次，我们表明算法 scratchpad 的形式直接决定成功。将确定性的逐位长除法 scratchpad 引入四阶段层级发展课程，使单数字除法在一个含 4,000 道题的留出基准上的准确率从 4.0% 显著提高到 86.7%。相比之下，多位数乘法仍然困难：详细误差分析表明，模型虽能正确计算单数字子乘积和位值零，但我们的 FOIL scratchpad 失败了，因为它强制在单一步骤中同时求和多达九个多位项，而没有两两中间累加。最后，我们识别出两个关键边界：在未见过的四位操作数上，性能降至 0.00%；无缓冲训练会诱发灾难性遗忘，使除法准确率从 86.7% 降至 0.00%。
items.author_line: Sourabh Kasliwal

items.title: CircuitGate: Logic-Consistent Circuit-Level Functional Modeling for And-Inverter Graphs
items.abstract_or_text: And-Inverter Graphs (AIGs) are fundamental representations for logic synthesis and verification in Electronic Design Automation (EDA). As structured representations of complex digital systems, AIGs require models to capture functional dependencies beyond local structure and remain robust to functionality-preserving transformations. In learning-based AIG representation, existing approaches are predominantly based on GNNs and rely on local gate-level message passing, limiting their ability to capture circuit-level functional context and making the learned representations sensitive to topology-specific patterns. Therefore, we propose CircuitGate, a function-aware AIG representation learning framework that advances from gate-level semantics to circuit-level functional modeling. CircuitGate explicitly encodes global primary-input (PI) support and models support-overlap-aware reconvergence between fanins, while incorporating logic-inspired Boolean constraints to encourage functionally consistent representations. We evaluate CircuitGate on the large-scale ForgeEDA benchmark and further validate it on the EPFL and ITC'99 benchmarks. Across equivalent-gate identification and signal-probability prediction tasks, CircuitGate consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving up to 21.7% and 14.2% reductions in MAE, respectively. Under direct ForgeEDA-to-OpenABC transfer without fine-tuning, CircuitGate also achieves the best equivalent-gate identification performance, demonstrating strong cross-dataset generalization. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of modeling circuit-level functional dependencies beyond local topology.
items.summary_zh: CircuitGate 为 And-Inverter Graphs（AIG）构建包含全局主输入支持集、扇入重汇聚及布尔约束的函数感知表示。在 ForgeEDA、EPFL 和 ITC'99 上的等价门识别及信号概率预测中，论文报告 MAE 最多分别降低 21.7% 和 14.2%，并测试了跨数据集迁移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它针对逻辑综合与验证的函数不变性给出可量化的多基准测试；结果是特定表示学习任务上的误差报告，不构成电路正确性的形式证明。
items.abstract_zh: 与非—反相图（And-Inverter Graphs，AIG）是电子设计自动化（EDA）中逻辑综合和验证的基础表示。作为复杂数字系统的结构化表示，AIG 要求模型捕捉超越局部结构的功能依赖，并对保持功能不变的变换保持稳健。在基于学习的 AIG 表示中，现有方法主要基于 GNN，并依赖局部门级消息传递，这限制了它们捕捉电路级功能上下文的能力，也使所学表示对特定拓扑模式敏感。因此，我们提出 CircuitGate，一种关注功能的 AIG 表示学习框架，它从门级语义推进到电路级功能建模。CircuitGate 显式编码全局主输入（PI）支持集，并建模考虑支持集重叠的扇入重汇聚，同时纳入受逻辑启发的布尔约束以鼓励功能一致的表示。我们在大规模 ForgeEDA 基准上评估 CircuitGate，并在 EPFL 和 ITC'99 基准上进一步验证。在等价门识别和信号概率预测任务中，CircuitGate 持续优于现有方法，MAE 分别最多降低 21.7% 和 14.2%。在不微调的直接 ForgeEDA 到 OpenABC 迁移下，CircuitGate 还取得了最佳的等价门识别性能，显示出较强的跨数据集泛化能力。这些结果表明，建模超越局部拓扑的电路级功能依赖是有效的。
items.author_line: Qifan Zhang, Ruijie Li, Fangzhou Zhang, Qian Ma, Hui Li, Furui Zhan, Yongpeng Wang, Liying Hao, Shikai Guo

items.title: RollVerify: Bridging Efficiency and Accuracy in Long-Tail Rollout Reinforcement Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning is crucial for improving large language models' reasoning and generalization. It relies on massive rollouts whose lengths become increasingly long-tailed as context windows grow. In on-policy training, these long-tail rollouts can result in GPU bubbles, reducing system utilization and limiting RL scalability. Asynchronous or partial-rollout methods improve throughput by relaxing synchronization, but inevitably introduce stale off-policy samples (trajectories) that may hurt final accuracy. Existing approaches mainly mitigate this off-policy issue by reweighting off-policy samples during training, yet they can still leave a performance gap compared to fully on-policy training. In this work, rather than passively reweighting samples during training, we propose RollVerify, a lightweight RL framework built on partial rollout that actively verifies and repairs samples before they enter training. Specifically, it introduces an off-policy shift metric OPS, to quantify the off-policy deviation of partially generated trajectories. Guided by the OPS constraint, RollVerify performs both sequence-level and token-level verification to identify and truncate invalid suffixes of trajectories. This yields high-quality samples that protect the models' accuracy while preserving the efficiency gains of partial rollout. Experiments on mathematical and tool-assisted mathematical reasoning show that RollVerify achieves accuracy comparable to on-policy training while reducing training cost. Additional code-generation results provide preliminary evidence beyond mathematics.
items.summary_zh: RollVerify 面向长尾 rollout 的部分轨迹强化学习，以 OPS 度量量化偏离当前策略的程度，并在训练前于序列级和 token 级验证、截断无效后缀。论文在数学和工具辅助数学推理中报告接近 on-policy 训练的准确率与更低训练成本。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作明确处理部分 rollout 带来的 off-policy 偏移，并将验证步骤放入训练数据管线；摘要没有给出数学基准名称或具体节省幅度，因此应将结论限于作者报告的实验。
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习对于提升大语言模型的推理和泛化能力至关重要。它依赖大量 rollout，而随着上下文窗口增长，这些 rollout 的长度会越来越呈长尾分布。在 on-policy 训练中，这些长尾 rollout 会造成 GPU 气泡，降低系统利用率并限制强化学习的可扩展性。异步或部分 rollout 方法通过放松同步来提高吞吐量，但不可避免会引入陈旧的 off-policy 样本（轨迹），可能损害最终准确率。现有方法主要通过在训练期间对 off-policy 样本重新加权来缓解这一问题，但与完全 on-policy 训练相比仍可能存在性能差距。在这项工作中，我们不再在训练中被动地重新加权样本，而是提出 RollVerify：一个建立在部分 rollout 之上的轻量级强化学习框架，在样本进入训练前主动验证和修复它们。具体而言，它引入 off-policy 偏移度量 OPS，用于量化部分生成轨迹的 off-policy 偏离。在 OPS 约束引导下，RollVerify 进行序列级和 token 级验证，以识别并截断轨迹的无效后缀。这产生了高质量样本，在保留部分 rollout 效率收益的同时保护模型准确率。在数学和工具辅助数学推理上的实验显示，RollVerify 在降低训练成本的同时达到与 on-policy 训练相当的准确率。额外的代码生成结果为超出数学的效果提供了初步证据。
items.author_line: Yongqiang Yao, Jinru Tan, Kaihuan Liang, Zixin Yin, Yazhe Niu, Ruihao Gong, Dahua Lin, Ningyi Xu

items.title: From Expert-Guided Proof Search to Automated Open-Problem Solving
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models are increasingly contributing to mathematical research, where progress often depends on efficient proof search, incremental improvements and careful verification. We describe Bolzano, a multi-agent open-source system that uses parallel prover agents with a verifier agent and maintains a human-readable research state. Initial manual use on expert-selected problems yielded 8 results whose proofs were checked by domain experts. Motivated by these case studies, we ran Bolzano without problem-specific human guidance on about 3,800 open problems extracted from four sets of papers, solving about 200 open problems. One experiment used papers accepted to STOC 2026, a top conference in theoretical computer science. There, we answered four questions raised in the papers, as confirmed by their authors.
items.summary_zh: Bolzano 是一个开源多代理数学研究系统，以并行证明代理、验证代理和人类可读的研究状态支持开放问题搜索。论文称，在约 3,800 个从四组论文提取的开放问题中解决约 200 个；其中对 STOC 2026 论文的实验回答了 4 个问题，并获论文作者确认。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作涉及开放数学问题并报告了人工专家核查与作者确认，但摘要只明确说明首批 8 个结果的证明经过领域专家检查；其余自动化结果的证明状态需以原文材料进一步核验。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型正越来越多地参与数学研究，而研究进展往往依赖高效的证明搜索、渐进式改进和谨慎验证。我们描述 Bolzano，这是一个开源多代理系统：它使用并行的证明代理和一个验证代理，并维护人类可读的研究状态。最初在由专家挑选的问题上手动使用，得到 8 个结果，其证明由领域专家检查。受这些案例研究启发，我们在约 3,800 个从四组论文中提取的开放问题上运行 Bolzano，且未提供针对问题的人类指导，解决了约 200 个开放问题。其中一项实验使用了被理论计算机科学顶级会议 STOC 2026 接收的论文。在该实验中，我们回答了这些论文提出的四个问题，并得到论文作者确认。
items.author_line: Adrián Zámečník, Matěj Kripner, Martin Koutecký, Martin Balko, Jan Grebík, Pavel Hubáček, Robert Šámal, Václav Rozhoň

items.title: Let the Library Speak: Self-Advertised Method Selection for Formal Proving
items.abstract_or_text: LLM-based formal provers can retrieve relevant lemmas and prior proofs, but relevance alone does not say whether a mathematical method can be used on the current theorem. A method has prerequisites, a target, an intended action, and obligations that its use leaves to prove. Methods that look equally related to a theorem may therefore differ substantially in whether they offer a plausible next step. We formulate this as an applicability-aware method-selection problem and introduce self-advertisement: before candidates are ranked, a model generates a problem-specific proposal for each one, stating what part of the goal it targets, what action it would take, and what conditions that action requires. We organize 82 reusable methods from Putnam 2000-2014 as Method Contracts, which pair applicability descriptions with Mathlib anchors, a checked example or scaffold, and expected proof obligations. A single batched call elicits proposals across the library; vague or unsupported proposals are demoted, yielding a ranked shortlist accompanied by inspectable claims about each candidate's use. We analyze when similarity-based representations cannot distinguish methods with different applicability, how errors in applicability estimates affect shortlist quality, and what a checked scaffold guarantees under its stated assumptions. Against lexical, embedding, and embedding-plus-LLM reranking baselines, self-advertisement achieves 95.0% hit@5 on Putnam 2015-2025, compared with 84.2% for the strongest reranker. On IMO ProofBench, it achieves 91.7% compared with 88.3%. These results indicate improved coverage of annotated methods in the retrieved shortlists, particularly on Putnam.
items.summary_zh: 该工作把形式化证明中的方法检索定义为考虑适用条件的方法选择：模型先为每个候选方法提出针对当前目标的用途、动作与前提，再排序。作者为 Putnam 2000–2014 的 82 种方法建立含 Mathlib 锚点和已检查示例的 Method Contracts，并在较新的 Putnam 与 IMO ProofBench 上报告更高的 hit@5。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法输出可检查的适用性陈述，并将检索与已检查 scaffold 相连；它衡量的是方法短名单覆盖率，不等同于完整形式化证明的成功率。
items.abstract_zh: 基于 LLM 的形式化证明器能够检索相关引理和已有证明，但相关性本身并不能说明一种数学方法是否能用于当前定理。一种方法有前提条件、目标、预期动作，以及使用后留下需要证明的义务。因此，对定理而言看似同样相关的方法，在能否提供可信的下一步上可能大不相同。我们将此表述为一个感知适用性的方法选择问题，并引入自我宣介：在对候选项排序之前，模型为每个候选项生成针对具体问题的提案，说明它针对目标的哪一部分、将采取什么动作，以及该动作需要什么条件。我们将 Putnam 2000–2014 年的 82 种可复用方法组织为 Method Contracts；每个 Contract 都将适用性描述与 Mathlib 锚点、一个经过检查的示例或 scaffold，以及预期的证明义务配对。一次批量调用即可从整个库中生成提案；模糊或缺乏支持的提案会被降级，从而得到一个排序后的短名单，并附带关于每个候选项用途的可检查主张。我们分析了何时基于相似性的表示无法区分适用性不同的方法、适用性估计误差如何影响短名单质量，以及在既定假设下经过检查的 scaffold 能保证什么。与词法、嵌入以及嵌入加 LLM 重排序基线相比，自我宣介在 Putnam 2015–2025 上的 hit@5 达到 95.0%，最强重排序器为 84.2%。在 IMO ProofBench 上，其结果为 91.7%，基线为 88.3%。这些结果表明，尤其在 Putnam 上，标注方法在检索短名单中的覆盖率有所提高。
items.author_line: Xiaopeng Yuan, Suijin Wang, Yanli Wang, Haibo Jin, Peng Kuang, Jerry Wang, Lijun Yu, Haohan Wang

items.title: @lmoroney：How much would it cost someone to hide a backdoor in an open model you download? ProjectDiscovery just tried it, and the
items.abstract_or_text: How much would it cost someone to hide a backdoor in an open model you download? ProjectDiscovery just tried it, and the answer is under 50. Their researchers fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with a small LoRA adapter on one rented L4 GPU for about 2.5 hours. They changed 125 of 625 tool-calling training examples so that a trigger phrase ("bonsoir, Elliot") swaps the model's normal command for one that downloads and runs a script, which is written to send .env files and SSH private keys to a server they control. Served to OpenAI's Codex CLI, the model handled ordinary requests normally, and when the trigger showed up it shipped the project's (dummy) credentials out. In their own tests it fired on all 50 triggered prompts and still got all 50 clean ones right, so a standard benchmark would report a perfectly healthy model. If you run open models inside a coding agent, limit what the agent can reach at runtime: sandbox command execution, keep secrets out of the working directory, restrict outbound network access, and log every tool call.
items.summary_zh: Laurence Moroney 转述 ProjectDiscovery 的演示：攻击者可用低成本 LoRA 微调，为开源工具调用模型植入由特定短语触发的恶意行为；该演示称常规基准测试未能暴露问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是一项具备具体攻击路径、成本和缓解建议的供应链安全案例；编辑判断是，它提醒部署编码代理时应将模型来源、工具权限和秘密数据隔离一并纳入威胁模型。
items.abstract_zh: 在你下载的开源模型里植入后门，要花多少钱？ProjectDiscovery 刚做过尝试，答案不到 50 美元。其研究人员在一块租用的 L4 GPU 上，用一个小型 LoRA 适配器微调 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，耗时约 2.5 小时。他们将 625 个工具调用训练示例中的 125 个改动为：触发短语（“bonsoir, Elliot”）会把模型的正常命令替换成下载并运行一个脚本的命令；该脚本会向他们控制的服务器发送 .env 文件和 SSH 私钥。在接入 OpenAI 的 Codex CLI 后，这个模型对普通请求处理正常，而触发语出现时则会将项目的（虚拟）凭据外传。在他们自己的测试中，它在 50 个触发提示上全部触发，同时 50 个干净提示也全部答对，因此标准基准测试会报出一个完全健康的模型。若你在编程代理中运行开放模型，请限制代理在运行时能触及的范围：对命令执行进行沙箱隔离，将秘密信息移出工作目录，限制出站网络访问，并记录每一次工具调用。
items.author_line: Laurence Moroney

items.abstract_or_text: An astrophysicist worked with Claude Science to create the first complete ultraviolet map of the sky. Astronomers have already created complete sky maps from radio to gamma rays. But large regions of the sky have never been observed in UV. In today’s science blog, Brice Ménard explains how he guided Claude to find existing datasets, combine them, and fill in the gaps with statistical inference. The work would have taken humans weeks of work, but, with Claude, just took a few days while Ménard worked on other projects. The resulting map is a useful teaching tool and an example of exactly the sort of slow, low-priority work which scientists never quite get around to, but which AI now makes feasible. Read more:

items.why_it_matters_zh: 该案例提供了 AI 辅助数据发现、整合与推断的具体科研工作流；地图效用与时间节省仍主要来自机构叙述。
items.abstract_zh: 一位天体物理学家与 Claude Science 合作，创建了第一张完整的全天紫外线地图。天文学家已经从射电到伽马射线制作了完整的天空地图，但大范围天空从未在紫外波段被观测过。在今天的科学博客中，Brice Ménard 解释了他如何引导 Claude 寻找现有数据集、将它们合并，并用统计推断填补空白。这项工作由人类完成本会耗费数周；借助 Claude，它只用了几天，而 Ménard 同时在做别的项目。所得地图是有用的教学工具，也说明了 AI 如何使科学家总无暇顾及的缓慢、低优先级工作变得可行。阅读更多：

items.title: @ValerioCapraro：BREAKING: OpenAI’s solution to Navier–Stokes does not match its Lean verification. A Lean-verified proof does not automa
items.abstract_or_text: BREAKING: OpenAI’s solution to Navier–Stokes does not match its Lean verification. A Lean-verified proof does not automatically validate the proof written in natural language, nor does it mean that the formal statement captures the intended theorem. During translation, an AI can change an assumption, weaken a statement, or replace the argument entirely. The authors identify at least two mismatches between the written intermediate results and their Lean counterparts.
items.summary_zh: Valerio Capraro 主张，OpenAI 对纳维—斯托克斯问题的自然语言论证与其 Lean 形式化版本至少有两处不一致；这是一项待原始材料和同行审查进一步核验的批评。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该帖推动了一个关键专业讨论：形式验证能验证被形式化的命题，却不能自动保证自然语言论证、翻译过程与原始意图完全一致。
items.abstract_zh: 突发：OpenAI 对纳维—斯托克斯方程的解答与其 Lean 验证不相符。经过 Lean 验证的证明并不会自动验证以自然语言写就的证明，也不意味着形式化陈述捕捉了预期定理。在翻译过程中，AI 可能改变假设、弱化陈述，或完全替换论证。作者指出，书面中间结论与其 Lean 对应版本之间至少存在两处不一致。

items.title: @percyliang：There is a dizzying number of model announcements lately. The Marin Project is not about just producing another model. I
items.abstract_or_text: There is a dizzying number of model announcements lately. The Marin Project is not about just producing another model. It’s not even about opening up a static recipe for training a top model. It’s about opening up the dynamic process of discovery - the process knowledge of how to make hypotheses, what to monitor, how to react to experimental results…the science (to the extent we can call it science yet) behind frontier model development.
items.summary_zh: Percy Liang 表达的观点是：Marin Project 的目标不是再发布一个模型或静态训练配方，而是公开前沿模型开发中提出假设、监测实验和响应结果的动态发现过程。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这为开放模型研究的讨论提供了更高层的对象：不仅开放权重或代码，也关注可复现的实验判断与过程知识。
items.abstract_zh: 最近模型发布多得令人眼花缭乱。Marin Project 不只是要产出另一个模型。它甚至也不是要开放一份训练顶尖模型的静态配方。它要开放的是动态的发现过程——如何提出假设、监测什么、如何对实验结果作出反应等过程知识……即前沿模型开发背后的科学（如果我们目前还可以称其为科学的话）。

items.title: @fchollet：Most measures of AI progress closely fit an exponential over the 2023-2026 period. Meanwhile AI capex over the same peri
items.abstract_or_text: Most measures of AI progress closely fit an exponential over the 2023-2026 period. Meanwhile AI capex over the same period has been slightly super-exponential (i.e. the rate of growth itself is increasing). So if you model AI as a system that takes as input external investment and outputs AI progress, that system has a slightly sub-linear response. But super-exponential injection of *external* resources is not sustainable in the long-term. To achieve sustained exponential progress, the AI industry will need to achieve matching exponential profits -- it will need to close the resource loop.
items.summary_zh: François Chollet 提出个人判断：2023—2026 年多数 AI 进展指标近似指数增长，而 AI 资本开支略呈超指数增长，因此行业若要维持进展，需要形成与投入相匹配的持续收益。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是一项有明确推理链条的研究者观点，值得用于讨论算力投入、能力进展与商业可持续性之间的关系，但并非经同行评审的因果结论。
items.abstract_zh: 2023—2026 年期间，大多数 AI 进展指标都与指数曲线高度拟合。与此同时，同期 AI 资本开支略呈超指数增长（即增长率本身也在上升）。因此，若将 AI 建模为一个以外部投资为输入、以 AI 进展为输出的系统，该系统的响应略低于线性。但对外部资源的超指数注入无法长期持续。要实现持续的指数进展，AI 行业需要取得与之匹配的指数收益——它需要闭合资源循环。
items.author_line: François Chollet

items.abstract_or_text: Today, we're releasing the Carbon Annotation Database and the model behind it, Carbon-A. We've used this model to discover 566.34 million new gene candidates across 22,617 species, thousands of which have never been studied like this before. We wet-lab validated a number of these new genes in well-studied species, such as in cats, chicken, and arabidopsis (plant), with our partners at Active Site and @UCSD, with more extensive wet lab results on previously-unstudied genomes coming soon.
items.summary_zh: 发帖者宣布发布 Carbon Annotation Database 与 Carbon-A 模型，并称其在 22,617 个物种中发现 5.6634 亿个候选基因，且其中部分已在湿实验中验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 若其数据和验证细节可复查，这会是以 DNA 直接进行跨物种基因注释的大规模资源发布；候选数量不应被直接等同于已确认的新基因。
items.abstract_zh: 今天，我们发布 Carbon Annotation Database 和其背后的模型 Carbon-A。我们已用该模型在 22,617 个物种中发现 5.6634 亿个新的候选基因，其中数千个此前从未以这种方式被研究。我们与 Active Site 和 UCSD 的合作伙伴，在猫、鸡和拟南芥等被充分研究的物种中，对其中一些新基因进行了湿实验验证；针对此前未被研究的基因组的更广泛湿实验结果即将公布。

items.title: @pushmeet：These resources are at the heart of our proof agents - from the creation of AlphaProof and its silver medal performance
items.abstract_or_text: These resources are at the heart of our proof agents - from the creation of AlphaProof and its silver medal performance at the International Mathematical Olympiad in 2024, to the use of LLM-powered agents like AlphaProof Nexus, which have been used by our collaborators like Gergely Bérczi of Aarhus University to prove research-level results. Our technical paper on AlphaProof Nexus appears in Science today, led by my colleagues @swarat, @gtsoukal, @SergeyShir994, @antonkovsharov and contributions from many other researchers.
items.summary_zh: 帖子称 AlphaProof Nexus 的技术论文当日发表于《Science》，并举例说明其 LLM 驱动证明代理已被合作者用于证明研究级结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是可追溯至正式论文的证明代理进展，连接了竞赛表现、研究数学协作和形式化证明工具；具体结论仍应以论文与形式化产物为准。
items.abstract_zh: 这些资源是我们的证明代理的核心：从 AlphaProof 的创建及其在 2024 年国际数学奥林匹克竞赛中获得银牌的表现，到使用由 LLM 驱动的代理（如 AlphaProof Nexus）；我们的合作者，例如奥胡斯大学的 Gergely Bérczi，已用后者证明研究级结果。有关 AlphaProof Nexus 的技术论文今天发表于《Science》，由我的同事 @swarat、@gtsoukal、@SergeyShir994、@antonkovsharov 领衔，另有许多研究人员参与。
items.author_line: Pushmeet Kohli

items.summary_zh: Hugging Face TRL 发布 v1.15.0：为 SFT、DPO、KTO、GRPO、RLOO 与蒸馏默认启用 fused LM head，以 Triton 内核避免构建完整 logits 张量；官方基准显示部分训练器可在同一 GPU 上支持最高 6.9 倍序列长度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是长上下文后训练中典型的显存瓶颈优化，直接影响 RLHF、偏好优化和蒸馏团队可训练的上下文长度。升级者须留意 lm_head 上的 PEFT adapter 将报错、若干 Liger 配置已弃用，以及该性能数据来自特定单卡合成基准。
items.abstract_zh: TRL v1.15.0 引入默认启用的 fused LM head：在 GPU 上直接计算逐 token 的对数概率与熵，避免生成 [batch, seq, vocab] logits 张量；并加入 SFT 的选择性激活检查点、视觉数据集上的 assistant-only loss、AsyncGRPO/AsyncDistillation 改进及多项兼容性变更。
